statement.p: Let \vec{x} = \left[\begin{array}{c} 2\cr 2\cr -4\cr 0 \end{array}\right], \ \vec{y} = \left[\begin{array}{c} -1\cr 3\cr -8\cr 1 \end{array}\right], \ \vec{z} = \left[\begin{array}{c} 0\cr 2\cr -5\cr -20.5 \end{array}\right]. Use the Gram-Schmidt process to determine an orthonormal basis for the subspace of {\mathbb R}^4 spanned by \vec{x}, \vec{y}, and \vec{z}.
